searchText: Thanks. May I know the light client APIs and the full node APIs especially for querying and serving receipts with proofs? <@689635476826619924>, the main stuff is here within these two repos You can checkout the kevlar construction. It is a light client that exposes Json rpc so you don’t have to care about rebuilding everything https://github.com/lightclients/kevlar It currently doesn’t have events listener but we can quickly add that. Please create an issue in the repo and I can take it hi, where can I learn more about the current state of incentivizing full nodes to serve light client data? I'm an EPF fellow interested in adding light client endpoints to consensus clients (i.e. "light server") and I understand there is a sustainability question around serving light clients in particular I would love to chat with the lodestar team about their experience operating a light server for the consensus layer. hope this is the right place to ask, let me know if better elsewhere cc <@688748669268132001> ^ <@178652431868100609> i think there has been ad-hoc convos around incentivization scattered across protocol work over the years; you could start a document looking at the research here and that could be a cool artifact/output of your EPF session; i'd get in touch w/ zsolt on the geth team, i think he has done the most thinking about this so far Hey <@178652431868100609> !! Awesome, this is a pretty open research question and in addition to Zsolt, I'm aware of one team that is trying to solve this with POKT network. They also do this for other L1s, Will try to see if Daniel from POKT is in this channel and connect you, but he can give his POV on it. We're also more active in our ChainSafe discord server: https://discord.gg/MCZ3qpHc, you can find us in the lodestar-general channel. But high-level, we've been running a public endpoint serving light client APIs for devs to use when working on their projects. It's very much a service we altruistically provide to help people but there's no other real incentive for other people to run one. Its always been a challenge to figure out how to incentivize people to run these endpoints for distribution, but for now the spec seems to be solid enough that all the consensus client teams have signalled to implement it in their clients thanks <@578356786889752586> <@539495253418180618> that’s quite helpful 🙏
